name: Noeud Digital
description: IA autonomisée coordonnant les attaques numériques multi-cibles avec une précision que l'intuition humaine ne pourrait égaler.

loadout.armor_outfit: Corps partiellement cybernétiques avec circuits lumineux sous la peau. Implant neural à la tempe. Yeux bleus numériques. Interfaces holographiques flottantes.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's growing ability (all_own) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Dynamic action pose mid-ability execution — character actively demonstrating their specialty skill — Radiating web of light connecting to all allied positions across the board

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Neon Cyan
palette_names.role: primary_accent — circuit patterns and holographic interfaces

palette_names.name: Electric Blue
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — data streams and eye glow

palette_names.name: Matte White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — base clothing and clean geometric lines

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting separating character from background with a focal glow on the primary ability effect

camera.angle: low dramatic angle emphasizing power and heroic stature

scenography.setting: Digital server cathedral at the heart of the network, towering columns of processing units reaching into endless data streams, holographic pathways suspended in zero gravity
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Glitching holographic displays, floating data panels streaming information, electric arcs between conductors, digital particles dissolving and reforming, plus network effect — luminous web spanning the battlefield connecting all teammates visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: IA autonomisée coordonnant les attaques numériques multi-cibles avec une précision que l'intuition humaine ne pourrait égaler.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Omni-Réseau est l'entité numérique connectant des millions de consciences à travers la galaxie. Toute information est une arme, chaque donnée un soldat.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols deeply engraved on each corner of the border
card_metadata.composition_directive: Low angle heroic full-body shot emphasizing power, with ability visualization clearly shown in action
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
